latest_release.name: Kubeflow Subprojects Releases
latest_release.body:
Kubeflow brings together multiple open-source projects, each focused on a different stage of the [AI lifecycle](https://www.kubeflow.org/docs/started/architecture/#introducing-the-ai-lifecycle).

If you want to install Kubeflow please refer to https://www.kubeflow.org/docs/started/installing-kubeflow/.

Each project follows its own release cycle, please find links to the releases below:

| Kubeflow Project        | GitHub Releases                                                                  |
|-------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Kubeflow SDK            | [`kubeflow/sdk`](https://github.com/kubeflow/sdk/releases)                       |
| Kubeflow Notebooks      | [`kubeflow/notebooks`](https://github.com/kubeflow/notebooks/releases)           |
| Kubeflow Spark Operator | [`kubeflow/spark-operator`](https://github.com/kubeflow/spark-operator/releases) |
| Kubeflow Trainer        | [`kubeflow/trainer`](https://github.com/kubeflow/trainer/releases)               |
| Kubeflow Katib          | [`kubeflow/katib`](https://github.com/kubeflow/katib/releases)                   |
| Kubeflow Hub | [`kubeflow/model-registry`](https://github.com/kubeflow/model-registry/releases) |
| Kubeflow Pipelines      | [`kubeflow/pipelines`](https://github.com/kubeflow/pipelines/releases)           |

_NOTE: the `kubeflow/kubeflow` repository no longer contains the code for the Kubeflow projects._
